nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real Banach space and let $f : E \to \mathbb{R}$ have a strict derivative $f'$ at $x \in E$, a continuous linear map $E \to \mathbb{R}$ that is surjective. Then for every $v \in E$ with $f'(v) = 0$ there is a curve $\varphi : \mathbb{R} \to E$ with $\varphi(0) = x$ and $\varphi'(0) = v$ such that $f(\varphi(t)) = f(x)$ for all $t$ in some neighbourhood of $0$.
nodes.title: Kernel vectors are velocities of local curves in a level set

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real Banach space, $f : E \to \mathbb{R}$ a $C^1$ function, $c \in \mathbb{R}$, and $x \in E$ a point with $f(x) = c$ at which the derivative $Df(x) : E \to \mathbb{R}$ is surjective. Then for every $v \in E$ with $Df(x)v = 0$ there is a curve $\gamma : \mathbb{R} \to E$ with $\gamma(0) = x$, $\gamma'(0) = v$ and $f(\gamma(t)) = c$ for all $t \in \mathbb{R}$.
nodes.title: Kernel vectors are velocities of curves in a regular level set

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real normed space, $c \in \mathbb{R}$, and $f : E \to \mathbb{R}$ a function differentiable at $x \in E$. If a curve $\gamma : \mathbb{R} \to E$ satisfies $\gamma(0) = x$, has derivative $v$ at $0$, and satisfies $f(\gamma(t)) = c$ for all $t \in \mathbb{R}$, then $Df(x)v = 0$.
nodes.title: Velocities of curves in a level set lie in the kernel of the derivative

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
